# RevenueDot

> RevenueDot is the open-source RevenueCat alternative: open-source monetization infrastructure for mobile apps (the SDKs, the server, paywalls, experiments, web checkout, Customer Center, 43 charts and 36 integrations) that works with the RevenueCat SDK, so an app switches by changing one line of code. Self-host it free (AGPL-3.0 server, MIT SDKs) or use RevenueDot Cloud, free up to $10,000 a month in tracked revenue and never more than $999 a month after that.

Status: first release v2026.10.03. A real App Store sandbox purchase ran end to end on a physical iPhone on 2026-10-02, a production app has run RevenueDot beside RevenueCat since 2026-10-02, and RevenueDot Cloud has billed real cards through Stripe since 2026-10-03. Google Play, Amazon, Paddle, Roku and Galaxy Store are tested against copies of each store's API; their first real purchases are next.
